blocks.html: CareHub showed one workflow at a time, even when a member had several in progress. Clinicians had to search across tabs to understand the full picture.

Before: related care-plan work lived in a separate tab. I led a member-first redesign that brought open tasks into the member view, above the summary, so clinicians could scan the situation alongside the conversation.
